s: Din hammaskir sadeh umerchatz lenokri ubo t"z seipim: aseru chakamim lomar lenokri laasot lanu melaka beshabbat, ben bechinnam ben besakar, veap al pi sheomer lo miqqodem hashshabbat sheyyaaseh beshabbat, veap al pi sheeno tzarik leotah melaka ad leachar hashshabbat, shekkeshehannokri oseh beshabbat hu oseh bishlichut hayyisrael. Veap al pi sheen omerim "shelucho shel adam kemoto" min hattora ella beyisrael hannaaseh shaliach leyisrael, shenneemar bitruma "ken tarimu gam attem terumat Hashem", vedareshu chakamim "gam" lerabbot sheluchakem, mikkan she"shelucho shel adam kemoto", uma "attem" bene berit ap sheluchakem bene berit, abal hannokri eno betorat shelichut min hattora, mikkol maqom middibre soperim yesh shelichut lenokri lechumera. Veyesh remez leissur zeh beshabbat veyom tob min hattora, shenneemar beyom tob "kol melaka lo yeaseh bahem", mashma apillu al yede acherim sheen metzuvvim al hashshebita beyom tob, veqal vachomer leshabbat. Umikkol maqom, en zo ella asmakta bealma. Veiqqar haissur amira lenokri ben beshabbat ben beyom tob eno ella middibrehem, kede shello tehe shabbat qalla beene haam veyabou laasot beatzman, veken beyom tob, vaapillu bechullo shel moed, veken bishar kol issurin shebbattora, kemo sheyyitbaaru bimqoman:

Vehipligu chakamim beissur zeh vegazeru bo gezerot, kegon im asa hannokri meatzmo bishbil yisrael — aseru lehanot beshabbat mimmelakto ulemotzae shabbat ad bikde sheyyeaseh, mishshum gezera shemma yomru lo laasot beshabbat. Veken im roehu oseh melaka beshabbat bishbilo — peamim shetztzarik limchot, kegon im yaggia leyisrael revach mimmenna apillu leachar hashshabbat (veim gam lo maggia revach mimmenna — yitbaer besimman rm"d veran"b):

Lepikak mi sheyyesh lo merchatz sherochatzim bah hakkol venotenim lo sakar, o sheyyesh lo tannur sheopin bo hakkol venotenim lo sakar, o sheyyesh lo rechayim shettochanin bahen hakkol venotenin lo sakar, verotzeh liskor lo nokri lekol hashshana sheyyitasseq bekol hammelakot hatztzerikot bammerchatz verechayim vetannur, viqabbel hassakar min harochatzim vehattochanim vehaopim vibiehu lehayyisrael — tzarik hu limchot behannokri velo yannichennu sheyyitasseq bahem beshabbat bishbil nokrim sheyyirchatzu veyitchanu veyopu sham, lepi shehayyisrael marviach baabodat hannokri beshabbat, shemmaggia lo sakar mizzeh. (Vaapillu im hannokri eno tzarik laabod kelum, shekkebar hekin hakkol meereb shabbat, mikkol maqom mah shehannokri hazzeh meqabbel hassakar mehannokrim hu oseh zeh bishbil hayyisrael, ulehayyisrael atzmo asur lo leqabbel hassakar shel yom hashshabbat, laken asur gam ken sheyyeqabbel hannokri bishbilo). Veen lehattir lepi shehannokri toreach leatzmo bishbil hassakar sheqqatzatz lo, kevan sheim haya hayyisrael monea et atzmo merevach hashshabbat vehaya omer lannokri shello yihyeh kelal beshabbat etzel hammerchatz verechayim vetannur lo haya menakkeh lo kelum missekaro, shehare lo sekaro lekol yom veyom bipne atzmo ella leshana o chodesh bebat achat. Veap al pi shehannokri eno maaleh al dato shehayyisrael eno makricho lehitasseq beshabbat vesheyyeshallem lo kol sekaro ap im lo yitasseq kelal beshabbatot, ella hu oseq lepi tummo lehashlim qabbelanuto sheqqibbel alayv bitchillat sekiruto bistam lehitasseq kol hashshana o hachodesh kede sheyyeshallem lo kol sekaro mishshalem velo yihyeh lo alayv shum taromot, veim ken hannokri mitkavven letobat atzmo, mikkol maqom kevan (shebbeemet) sheen lehannokri toba verevach meeseq zeh shebbeshabbat, sheap im lo yitasseq beshabbat lo yenakkeh lo kelum missekaro, ulehayyisrael maggia revach mizzeh, im ken nireh haddabar keillu eseq zeh hu bishbil hayyisrael bilbad:

Vekol shekken sheim sakar hannokri leyamim, sheamar lo bead kol yom veyom shettitasseq bammerchatz o tannur o rechayim etten leka kak vekak, ap al pi shello amar lo sheyyitasseq beshabbat, vehannokri meatzmo holek umitasseq gam beshabbat — tzarik limchot beyado velo yannichennu lehitasseq beshabbat, sheap shehannokri mitkavven letobat atzmo kede littol hassakar sheqqatzatz lo bead kol yom, mikkol maqom kevan shehu oseh ken mechamat dibburo shel yisrael shessekaro lehitasseq ezeh yamim — hare zeh keoseq bishlichut hayyisrael, sheap shehayyisrael lo amar lo lehitasseq beshabbat ella sekaro leezeh yamim setam, mikkol maqom hannokri shemmitasseq beshabbat mitasseq hu mechamat hassekirut shessekaro hayyisrael leezeh yamim, vahare bedato hayyom shehu sekiro shel yisrael hayyom vehu oseh shelichut hayyisrael, lepikak ap sheoseh bishbil tobat atzmo — en zeh moil kelum, shelleinyan shelichut en lechalleq ben oseh letobat hamshalleach ben oseh letobat hashshaliach, ben kak uben kak shelucho hu:

Apillu im sakar hannokri leshana, im abar velo micha beyado vehinnicho lehitasseq beshabbat vehebi hannokri et hassakar lehayyisrael, ap al pi shello hebi lo sakar sheqqibbel beyom hashshabbat bipne atzmo ella hebio behablaa im shear hayyamim, kegon shehebi lo bebat achat sekar arbaa vachamishsha yamim veyom hashshabbat benehem, sheen bazeh issur mishshum sekar shabbat kemo sheyyitbaer bisip y"a — ap al pi ken asur lehayyisrael lehanot min hassakar sheqqibbel hannokri beyom hashshabbat, sheqqenasuhu chakamim:

Abal im rotzeh hayyisrael lehaskir hammerchatz lannokri sheyyaabod bo hannokri bekol emat sheyyirtzeh velo yihyeh mukrach baabodato, veyittol kol hassakar leatzmo, raq sheyyitten lehayyisrael dabar qatzub bekol shana o bekol chodesh, ben sheyyassiqennu o lo yassiqennu — min haddin haya muttar, sheap shehannokri yaabod bo beshabbat, hare eno mitkavven baabodato letobat hayyisrael ella letobat atzmo, shehare ap im lo yassiqennu beshabbat lo yenakkeh lehayyisrael kelum missekaro, veap im haya hayyisrael menakkeh lo im lo haya massiqo, ap al pi ken haya massiqo kede lehistakker, nimtza sheoseh raq letobat atzmo. Ap al pi ken aseru chakamim laasot ken, mippene marit haayin, lepi sheshshem hayyisrael niqra al hammerchatz, shehakkol yodeim shemmerchatz zeh hu shel yisrael, ukesheyyiru shennokrim rochatzim bemerchatzo shel yisrael beshabbat, venokri mitasseq bammerchatz — yomru shennokri zeh hu sekir yom etzel hayyisrael, veyachsheduhu sheober al dibre soperim bemah shemmanniach et hannokri lehitasseq beshabbat (o epshar yachshedu et hayyisrael shehu sakar lo nokri zeh sheyyitasseq bemerchatzo beshabbat). Veap sheggam hayyisreelim rachatzu betoko lipamim bechol verau shennokri zeh hu hammitasseq gam bechol, mikkol maqom lo yaaleh al datam shehayyisrael hiskir hammerchatz lenokri zeh sheyyittol kol hassakar leatzmo, venokri zeh mitasseq bo ledaat atzmo shello bishlichut hayyisrael, lepi sheen derek rob haolam liskor hammerchatz, lepi shehotzaotayv merubbot usekaro muat, veen hassakar maspiq lehassoker litten dabar qatzub lebaal hammerchatz vesheyyishtayyer lo sak chashub yater al sekar torcho vaamalo, lepikak derek haolam shekkol mi sheyyesh lo merchatz soker lo poel sheyyitasseq bo vekol hassakar hu lebaal hammerchatz:

Abal muttar lehaskir sadeh lenokri sheyyaabod abodatah kol emat sheyyirtzeh velo yihyeh mukrach baabodato veyittol kol happerot leatzmo, raq sheyyitten lehayyisrael dabar qatzub bekol shana, ben sheyyitten lo maot ben sheyyitten lo mipperot sadeh zo, vehannokri obed apillu beshabbat. Veen lachush lemarit haayin, sheyyomru shehannokri sekir yom hu etzel hayyisrael, o shessekaro laabod admato beshabbat, lepi shedderek rob haolam hu litten hassadeh baarisut learis, dehaynu adam hamqabbel hassadot lechorshan ulezoran velaabod kol abodatan, venotel biskar abodato mechetza o shelish o rebia happerot vehashshear lebaal hassadeh, laken min hassetam kesheyyiru nokri obed beshabbat besadeh shel yisrael yomru shezzehu ariso shel hayyisrael, velitten hassadeh baarisut lenokri en bo shum issur kelal. Ap al pi sheyyesh lehayyisrael hanaa bammelaka shehaaris oseh besadehu beshabbat, shehare rob happerot shel hassadeh hem shel hayyisrael, mikkol maqom kevan shehannokri eno mitkavven bimlakto bishbil tobat hayyisrael, ella bishbil tobat atzmo, sheyyittol cheleq hammaggia lo mipperot hassadeh, ap al pi shemmeelayv neheneh hayyisrael — en bekak kelum. Raq sheyyizzaher shello yomar lo sheyyaaseh beshabbat:

Abal mi sheyyesh lo nokri sakir leshana sheyyaaseh kol hammelakot hatztzerikot lesadehu beotah shana, ap al pi shemmin haddin haya muttar lehannicho laabod sadehu beshabbat, shehare hannokri lahanaat atzmo hu mitkavven, kede sheyyittol hassakar sheqqatzatz lo, sheap shehayyisrael yeshallem lo ap im lo yaaseh otah melaka beshabbat, mikkol maqom hare yitztarek laasotah beyom acher, shehare sekaro lekol hammelakot hatztzerikot lesadehu kol hashshana, lekak hu oseh otah beshabbat, kede shello yitztarek laasotah beyom acher (vegam eno nireh kishlucho shel yisrael kemo sekir yom, mittaam sheyyitbaer besimman rm"d), mikkol maqom mippene marit haayin tzarik hu limchot beyado, sheharoeh et hannokri obed beshabbat besadeh shel yisrael lo yaaleh al dato shehu sekir shana, ella yidmeh lo shehu sekir yom. Velo ameru shebbiskirut sadeh en leesor mippene marit haayin lepi shedderek rob haolam litten hassadeh baarisut, ella keshehaemet ken hu, shennokri zeh haobed yesh lo zekut beperot sadeh zo kearis, veyoter mearis, shehare sekura hi etzlo vekol peroteha shello, veeno noten lebaal hassadeh ella dabar qatzub, lepikak kesheyyiru oto obed beshabbat yitlu lomar shearis hu veyesh lo cheleq beperot hassadeh uletobat atzmo hu mitkavven baabodato, veyachqeru acharayv beet haqqatzir im haemet hu ken, yimtzeu shebbeemet yesh lo zekut beperot hassadeh, mah sheen ken benokri shehu sekir shana kesheyyachqeru acharayv beet haqqatzir yiru sheen lo kelum beperot hassadeh, yitbarer lahem lemaprea shello haya aris, veyomru shessekir yom haya. Umikkol maqom, im hassadeh hi chutz lattechum — en leesor mippene marit haayin, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rm"d, ayyen sham:

Harechayim dinam kesadeh, shemmuttar lehaskiram lenokri leshana o lechodesh sheyyaabod veyitasseq bahem kol emat sheyyirtzeh veyittol kol hassakar leatzmo, raq sheyyitten lehayyisrael dabar qatzub, vehannokri obed apillu beshabbat. Veen lachush lemarit haayin, lepi sheggam harechayim derek rob haolam litten baarisut kemo sadot. Abal hattannur dino kemerchatz, sheasur lehaskiro lenokri yoter millesheshet yeme hachol, lepi shekkesheyyaasoq bo hannokri beshabbat — yesh bo mishshum marit haayin, sheyyomru shessekir yom hu, shekken hu derek hattannur laasoq bo al yede sekire yom velo lehaskiro velo litteno baarisut, lepi sheyyetziotayv merubbot usekaro muat kemo merchatz. Umikkol maqom, hakkol lepi minhag hammedina, shebbimqomot shedderek rob anshe hair lehaskir hattannur o hammerchatz o littenam baarisut velo laasoq bahem al yede sekire yom — muttar lehaskiram sham lenokri o littenam lo baarisut. Ubimqomot sheen derek rob anshe hair lehaskir rechayim velo littenam baarisut ella oseqim bahem al yede sekire yom — asur lehaskiram sham lenokri o littenam lo baarisut:

Veap bimqomot sheen derek rob anshe hair lehaskir merchatz o tannur o rechayim o littenam baarisut, mikkol maqom im yesh sham adam shehiskiram o netanam baarisut shana achar shana ad shennitparsem larabbim sheen darko liskor poalim ella lehaskiram o littenam baarisut — muttar lo lehaskiram lenokri o littenam lo baarisut:

Ap bemaqom shemmuttar lehaskir lenokri merchatz verechayim vetannur leyoter millesheshet yeme hachol — lo hittiru lo littol hassakar hammaggia lo bead yom hashshabbat ella keshehiskir lo et yom hashshabbat behablaa im shear hayyamim, kegon shehiskir lo leshana o lechodesh, sheamar lo bead kol shabua titten li kak vekak, o apillu bead kol g' yamim o kol b' yamim titten li kak vekak, shennimtza shello hiskir lo leyom hashshabbat bipne atzmo ella behablaa im yamim acherim, veachar kak keshehannokri meshallem lo hassakar meshallem bead kol shabua kak vekak, o bead kol g' yamim o bead kol b' yamim kak vekak, nimtza sheen meshallem lo sakar shel yom hashshabbat bipne atzmo ella behablaa im yom acher:

Abal im hiskir lo leyamim nipradim, sheamar lo ani maskir leka leshana o lechodesh ubead kol yom veyom titten li kak vekak, nimtza sheyyom hashshabbat muskar lehannokri bipne atzmo, shehare kol yom veyom hu sekirut bipne atzmo (veyukal lachazor bo beemtza shana o chodesh), lepikak ap al pi sheachar kak meshallem lo hannokri bead kol hayyamim bebat achat — asur lo littol sakar hammaggia lime hashshabbatot, shehare hannokri mechashsheb immo sekum yamim nipradim, umeshallem lo bead kol yom veyom, nimtza shemmeshallem bead yom hashshabbat bipne atzmo shello behablaa, veasur littol sekar shabbat shello behablaa, sheen mistakkerim beshabbat, mishshum gezerat miqqach umimkar:

Bimqomot sheasur lehaskir lenokri merchatz o tannur verechayim mippene marit haayin, im abar vehiskir — muttar lo leqabbel kol hassakar mehannokri, dekevan shello asa issur meiqqar haddin ella mippene marit haayin — en qonesin oto:
Ap bemaqom shemmuttar lehaskir lenokri merchatz tannur verechayim — lo yaskirem lo beereb shabbat ella qodem leken, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman rm"v, ayyen sham hattaam:

Ap bimqomot sheaseru lehaskir merchatz tannur verechayim lenokri — lo aseru ella keshenniqra shem hayyisrael alehem, sheyyadua umepursam larabbim shehem shel yisrael, sherau oto mitasseq bahem kamma peamim bimot hachol. Abal yisrael sheqqana minnokri merchatz tannur verechayim velo hitasseq bahem kelal, ella chazar vehiskiro miyyad lenokri acher — hare zeh muttar, lepi sheadayin lo niqra alehem shem hayyisrael, veen kan chashash marit haayin:

Veken im yesh leyisrael bet dira bechatzer acheret shehu eno dar betokah, vesham yesh merchatz beotah haddira, im kol yemot hachol en derek shum yisrael lirchotz beotah merchatz raq shekene haddira — muttar lo lehaskiro lenokri o litteno lo baarisut. Veen kan chashash marit haayin, lepi shekkol mi sheeno rochetz beoto merchatz kelal bimot hachol eno yodea shemmerchatz zeh hu shel yisrael, shekkevan shehu omed bechatzer bipne atzmo veen shum yisrael dar beotah chatzer, ushekene hammerchatz sherochatzin bah bechol yodein hen sheen hannokri sekir yom etzel hayyisrael vekol hassakar shennotenim bead harechitza noteno hannokri leyisrael, ella hiskiro lo o netano lo baarisut vekol hassakar shennotenin bead harechitza hu lehannokri. Abal im derek shum yisrael sheeno mishshekene hammerchatz lirchotz bo bechol, mittok shehu yotze veniknas bo yodea shehu shel yisrael, veachar kak kesheyyaabor sham lipamim beshabbat veyireh nokrim rochatzin bo — yachshod et yisrael baal hammerchatz lomar shennokri hammitasseq bammerchatz beshabbat hu sekir yom etzel hayyisrael:
